Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the game. Australia Women have booked their place in the semi-finals. The ICC Women's T20 World Cup continues as we have a doubleheader coming up on Sunday, 19th of February. Pakistan Women versus West Indies Women at 6.30 pm IST ( 1.00 pm GMT) and New Zealand Women versus Sri Lanka Women at 10.30 pm IST ( 5.00 pm GMT). Do join us a bit early for the build-up as well. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women starts by praising Tahlia McGrath's knocks. Says that the South African bowlers did well to put them under pressure. She thinks that the fight back from the side was incredible. Adds the atmosphere was electric. For once it felt like South Africa were flying but they did well to pull things back. Ends by saying that now the group will take a leave for couple of days before starting their preparations for the semis.

Sune Luus the skipper of South Africa Women says that they lost momentum with the bat once the opening stand was broken. Adds that there weren't enough runs on the board for the bowlers to defend. Says that they failed to put them under pressure and they will give their best in the next game. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support.

Tahlia McGrath is the Player of the Match for her knock of 57 runs. She says that she tried to keep it simple and carried on from them. Mentions that the atmosphere was incredible. Adds that the bowlers were incredible. Tells that she has been loving the way the top-order has been batting this campaign but she would certainly love to spend some more time at the crease.
Presentations coming up...

Earlier in the game, South Africa Women got off to a good start but once the opening stand was broken, the wickets kept on tumbling for them. Tazmin Brits played well and scored 45 runs. Australia Women were excellent with the ball and managed to restrict their opponents to a par score of 124 runs.

South Africa Women looked good at the start and chipped three wickets in a jiffy. They lost momentum after that and just couldn't get the wicket after that. They got Tahlia McGrath at the very end but the damage was already done. Marizanne Kapp was the only economical bowler and she chipped two wickets for the team. Masabata Klaas and Nonkululeko Mlaba picked one wicket each but were a bit expensive, keeping in mind the total they had on the board.

Yet another scintillating win for the Australia Women and they have booked their place in the semi-finals. Having to chase a par total. They got off to a shaky start and were reeling on 40/3 inside 7 overs. Ashleigh Gardner and Tahlia McGrath joined hands then and made sure they finish off the game. The former scored 28 runs while the latter went on to score 57 of just 33 deliveries. They won the match comprehensively by 6 wickets with 21 balls to spare.

FOUR! Grace Harris needs only one ball to finish things off. It is short and on off. Grace Harris pulls it low and hard through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence. Australia Women win the match by 6 wickets.

OUT! CAUGHT! It is a length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath uses her feet and slashes hard hoping to find a boundary. The ball though lobs high in the air off the outside edge and it goes towards backward point. Laura Wolvaardt takes a good catch diving forward. Grace Harris walks in next.
Commentary.Howout: c Laura Wolvaardt b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on fifth stump. Gardner shuffles across and dabs it to point. They cross.
WIDE! Klaas goes full, down leg. Ashleigh Gardner is unable to flick it away. Wide called. 5 more to win.
Around off, Gardner taps it into cover and gets to the other end.
Tahlia McGrath now drives this full ball down the ground. One taken.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Third one on the trot! It is full and on off. Tahlia McGrath dances down the track and creams it through covers for four more.

FOUR! Tahlia McGrath gets to her FIFTY in fine fashion. This is her first half-century in the T20 World Cup. It is short and outside off. Tahlia McGrath hangs back and cuts it past backward point. It races away to the fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Mlaba goes full and on off. Tahlia McGrath prods and lofts it over extra covers for a cracking boundary.
It is full, attacking the pads. Tahlia McGrath stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single. Australia Women clearly on top here. These two have taken the game away from the hosts.
Length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath dances down the track but gets an inside edge on her heave across the line. The ball rolls past the stumps.
Tahlia McGrath stands back to this short one and cuts it to deep point for a brace.
On off defended to covers.
FOUR! Top shot. 100 up for Australia Women. It is a length ball, on fifth stump. Tahlia McGrath plays it late and guides it down to the third man fence.
Length and on off, defended out.
Shorter, on middle. Tahlia McGrath knocks it towards mid on and crosses.
Short and on off, tapped to point.

FOUR! Tahlia McGrath is turning on the heat here. It is full and on off. Tahlia McGrath uses her feet and places it perfectly through the gap between extra cover and mid off. The ball has enough legs to reach the fence.
FOUR! Nicely played. It is pitched up, on off. Tahlia McGrath stands tall and crunches it through extra covers for a cracking boundary.
A single now as this is driven to covers.
FOUR! Australia Women now are finding boundaries in every over here. Short one, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner hangs back and cuts it past backward point for four runs.
A couple to end the over! Klaas serves a full-length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath uses her feet and lofts it over extra cover. The sweeper cover comes across and they take two.
Ashleigh Gardner now rotates the strike. It is a length ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner taps it to cover and takes off.
This is full, angled into the pads. Ashleigh Gardner fails to glance it around the corner. It bounces off the thigh pads.
A well-directed short ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner tries to play the upper cut but misses.
Touch fuller, on off. Ashleigh Gardner now punches it through covers for two runs.
FOUR! Ashleigh Gardner now joins the party. Pressure back on the hosts. Good length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner goes for the pull but it flies down to thid man off the outside edge. Four runs.
FOUR! Exceptional shot. This should release some pressure. It is a full-length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath lunges forward and creams it through extra cover for four runs.
Flatter and on off. Cut hard to covers.
A single now as this is pushed out to the off side.
It catches the outside edge once again but this time goes straight to the fielder at short fine leg. It does not carry as it is played with soft hands.

Tosses it up, around off, it grips and turns away. Tahlia McGrath tries to heave it through the line but gets a thick outside edge on it. The ball runs down to third man. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps it down to three.
Short one on off. Gardner pulls it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Slower one now, on middle and leg. Ashleigh Gardner flicks it to mid on and crosses.6 runs off the over.
Ismail serves a full-length ball, sliding down leg. Tahlia McGrath stays back and flicks it to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep is quick to come across and keep it down to a single.
Shabnim Ismail follows the batter down leg with a full one. Tahlia McGrath works it to mid on.
FOUR! Incredible shot. Ismails bangs it short, angled into the body. Tahlia McGrath pulls it flat and hard over mid-wicket. It races away to the fence.
On a length, angled in on leg. Tahlia McGrath tucks it to mid-wicket.
Ismail serves a length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath taps it out to point.

Drinks! Well, this match is turning out to be a thriller. Looking at Australia's start it looked like their will cruise through the innings. Although, that's not been the case here. Australia Women got off to a good start but South Africa Women have done well to pull things back. The hosts will hope to take a couple more wickets and put the defending champions under the pump.
On a length and on off, Ashleigh Gardner eases it to short covers.
Bowls it on off, Tahlia McGrath drives it towards covers for one.
FOUR! Fuller and outside leg, Tahlia McGrath leans back and guides it through backward point for another boundary.
FOUR! Fine shot. Slightly shorter and on leg, Tahlia McGrath uses the pace of the ball and helps it through fine leg for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Tahlia McGrath tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. Good running!
Bowls it on middle and leg, Tahlia McGrath eases it to the on side.
Bowls it on off, Ashleigh Gardner miscues her loft back towards the bowler.
Shorter and on leg, Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull it but misses.
Bowls oy down leg, Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull it but gets a hit on her thigh.
Good length, on off, Ashleigh Gardner drives it towards deep covers for a brace. Excellent fielding in the deep.
This one lands on middle, Ashleigh Gardner drives it back towards the bowler.
Bowls it on middle, Tahlia McGrath nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Lands it on off, Ashleigh Gardner lofts it over mid off for a brace.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner punches it to the cover fielder.
Fuller and on middle, it turns in a bit, Tahlia McGrath works it to mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls it on middle, Ashleigh Gardner flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Lands it outside off, Tahlia McGrath slaps it to point for one. She gets off the mark.
Bowls it outside off, Ashleigh Gardner punches it to covers for one.
Tahlia McGrath is the new batter in.

OUT! PLUMB! Marizanne Kapp gets the big fish. This one lands fuller and on middle, Beth Mooney looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Beth Mooney has a chat with her partner and decides to walk out. Australia Women lose their third wicket.
FOUR! Beth Mooney won't miss this. Slightly shorter and on off, Beth Mooney pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
Bowls it on off, Beth Mooney blocks it to mid-wicket. Oh, its a no ball. Free hit coming up...
On a length and on off, Ashleigh Gardner looks to play at it but edges it to third man for one.
This one lands on off, Ashleigh Gardner eases it to mid off. Dot.
Fuller again, on off, Beth Mooney guides it to backward point for one.
Fuller one, on off, Beth Mooney taps it to mid off.
FOUR! Fine shot. Lands it on middle, Ashleigh Gardner hangs back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
Another one on off, Ashleigh Gardner blocks it back towards the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Ashleigh Gardner eases it to mid on.
Bowls it on middle, Ashleigh Gardner defends it back.
Ashleigh Gardner is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust and the crowd is erupted here. Flatter and on middle and leg, Meg Lanning moves to her right to scoop it but misses it completely as the ball rattles over the stumps. The skipper makes her way back into the shed.
Slightly shorter and on off, Beth Mooney pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
LEG BYE! Length and on the pads. Beth Mooney fails to tickle it away. The ball dies on the leg side off the pads. They cross for a leg bye.
It is full, on off. Mooney blocks it out on her front foot.
Good length, on fourth stump. Lanning waits for it and steers it past backward point for one. The Australian skipper is off the mark here.

Full length, swinging away off the deck. Meg Lanning throws the kitchen sink at it but misses. The keeper and Marizanne Kapp make a loud appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. South Africa Women are quite certain here and they take the review. Although, the Ball Traking confirms that no bat is involved and South Africa Women lose a review here.
Much fuller, in the channel. Meg Lanning looks to defend it away but gets beaten as she does no inside the line.
The skipper, Meg Lanning walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The crowd comes back to life here. It is a good-length ball, around off, shaping away. Ellyse Perry tries to go for the cut shot but with offering any movement inside the crease. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to the right of first slip. Chloe Tryon there dives to that side and takes a sharp catch with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Ismail pitches it up, full and on off. Mooney clears her front leg and smacks it over mid on. The ball is over the ropes here.
Another single now! It is a short ball, on off. Perry works it to backward point off the top half of the blade. They take a quick single.
Full length, wide of off. Beth Mooney comes down the track and works it to mid off for a single.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on leg. Beth Mooney ducks under it and the umpire signals a wide.
Beth Mooney moves outside leg. Ismail follows her with a length ball. Mooney tries to work it through the off side but only connects with thin air.
A single now as this is dabbed down to mid off.
FOUR! Up and over. It is a length ball, on off. Perry gets under it and lofts it through the line. The mid off is up and it races away to the fence.
Length and on off, pushed out to safety. A probing over from Kapp comes to an end.

Marizanne Kapp dishes a length ball, on off, it nips in a touch. Beth Mooney tries to whip it across the line. She is hit on her pads. Kapp makes an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Later, it is confirmed that she gets an inside edge on it.
Play and a miss! It is a full-length ball, angling across the left-hander. Mooney steps across and tries to drive it through covers but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short one, outside off. Perry chops it past backward point for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. Kapp dishes it on a length, outside off. Perry dances down the track and crunches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Kapp goes full and on middle. Mooney steps across and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.

Goes high in the air but lands safely. Good length, on the bodyline. Mooney tries to flick it away but it catches the outside edge. The ball flies over the keeper's head. It goes towards fine leg. Two fielders go after it but only to collect it after the ball falls safely. One taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings! It is pitched up,in the arc of Mooney. She leans in and carves it through the gap at covers for four runs.
Ismail goes much fuller this time, on off. Mooney drives it to the off side.
A length ball, that lands on middle and nips in off the deck. Mooney gets pinged on her pads but clearly outside the line.
A length ball, angled across on off. Mooney dabs it out to point.
Full length, too straight on the pads. Beth Mooney stays back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Two taken.
Shabnim Ismail to share the attack from the other end.
Short ball, on middle. Perry goes back and nudges it to mid-wicket but for no run.
Touch short, on off. Perry defends it out watchfully.
Australia Women and Beth Mooney are off the mark here. Length and on off. Mooney taps it to cover and takes off to the other end.
Flatter and on off. Beth Mooney eases it to point.
A stifled appeal for lbw! It is tossed up, around middle. It turns in sharply off the deck. Mooney gets pinged on her pads. Going down leg.
Mlaba starts with a short one, outside off. Mooney rocks back and cuts it to backward point.
